properties.name: vanillabp.webapps.ui
properties.description: Which web applications of CIB seven the application serves: 'webclient' (the new webclient at /webapp), 'legacy' (the classic Cockpit, Tasklist and Admin at /camunda) or 'both'. 'legacy' and 'both' need the module cibseven-adapter-spring-boot-webapps-legacy. It holds for every adapter id whose webapps are enabled.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.enabled
properties.description: Whether the web applications serve the engine of this adapter id, the webclient as well as Cockpit, Tasklist and Admin. Switch it off for an engine which only exists for a migration. All keys of this section work for every adapter id of type 'cibseven', not only for the id 'cibseven'.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.admin-user.id
properties.description: The id of the administrator the start creates. Without an admin user the webapps show their setup wizard.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.admin-user.password
properties.description: The password of the administrator. It is never logged.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.admin-user.first-name
properties.description: The first name shown next to the administrator.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.admin-user.last-name
properties.description: The last name shown next to the administrator.

properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.cibseven.webapps.admin-user.email
properties.description: The mail address of the administrator.

values.description: CIB seven's new webclient at /webapp. This is the default.
The classic Cockpit, Tasklist and Admin at /camunda. Needs the module cibseven-adapter-spring-boot-webapps-legacy.
The webclient at /webapp and the classic web applications at /camunda. Needs the module cibseven-adapter-spring-boot-webapps-legacy.
